authorization.approved_object: B1_g3.0 single-point VASP, 32 ranks / 120 GB / max 2 h
authorization.note: authorizes ONE formal PBS submission only; not the three relaxations, Type-II, SOC, Wannier, IGMC, or auto-retry

key_settings.hubbard: LDAUTYPE=2, LDAUL=2 -1, LDAUU=4 0, LDAUJ=0 0 (Dudarev U_eff=4 eV Ag-4d)
key_settings.magmom: -1 1 1 -1 8*0  (Type-I interlayer Neel OPPOSITE; sign is relative spin order, not a SOC easy axis)
key_settings.ivdw_note: D3 zero damping (explicit operator choice, distinct from IVDW=12 D3(BJ); NOT claimed as original author private INCAR)
key_settings.ismear_note: Gaussian smearing chosen because the band gap is unknown; NOT the earlier  ISMEAR=1/SIGMA=0.1 precedent, which is explicitly rejected
key_settings.ibron_note: single point only; no structural relaxation

kpoints.note: cheap SCF diagnostic only; NOT k-converged production

potcar.note: version facts read from TITEL/ENMAX headers (Ag ENMAX 249.844, F 400.000); POTCAR content never uploaded

site.billing_note: CP_001 accepts partial-node requests (resources_max.ncpus=56 < 112-core nodes), so the job is accounted by requested CPUs; 64 requested core-hours is within the user-approved limit. No whole-node charge model observed on CP_001.
